known_limitations: Exact checkpoint-to-source historical equivalence remains unresolved.
The paper Hamming versus selected-source Hann window discrepancy remains unresolved.
Automatic resampling and arbitrary padded variable-length batches are not supported by the accepted integration.
CUDA and non-macOS platforms are outside this local verification scope.
panns-cnn14-16k-map-0438 requires sample_rate=16000; automatic resampling is not supported
PANNs integration does not yet define padded-batch semantics; every valid_lengths value must equal the waveform time dimension T
